# Mumei CLI Option Reference

| Command | Option count | Summary |
|---|---:|---|
| `mumei` | 1 | Formally verified language: parse → resolve → monomorphize → verify (Z3) → codegen (LLVM IR) |
| `mumei evidence` | 0 | Check common Evidence representation or produce fresh scoped source Evidence; no proof acceptance |
| `mumei evidence recheck-source` | 5 | Freshly recheck saved source Evidence with linked Z3 and caller-supplied source/budgets; not proof acceptance |
| `mumei evidence recheck-sidecar` | 5 | Freshly recheck a semantic-contract sidecar against caller-supplied source and LLVM IR bytes; hash binding and source-model obligations only, not LLVM correspondence or acceptance |
| `mumei evidence accept-sidecar` | 17 | Evaluate a semantic-contract sidecar's hash binding and fresh source obligations into a bounded acceptance descriptor |
| `mumei evidence accept-source` | 17 | Evaluate representation plus fresh same-profile source consistency into a bounded acceptance descriptor |
| `mumei evidence verify-source` | 4 | Freshly verify one C03 pure-i64 source postcondition, not LLVM/artifacts or proof acceptance |
| `mumei evidence check-readonly-slice` | 0 | Check read-only i64 slice source obligations with Z3; emits a JSON diagnostic, not Evidence or LLVM |
| `mumei evidence sign` | 5 | Detachably sign a bounded record's raw bytes with a declared ed25519 key into a producer-signature envelope; binds the declared key id only |
| `mumei evidence keygen` | 1 | Generate a fresh ed25519 producer keypair; writes the 64-char hex secret to a new file and prints only the public key |
| `mumei evidence check` | 3 | Validate one Evidence v1 JSON record's representation, not its truth, identity, freshness or authenticity |
| `mumei evidence check-schedule` | 2 | Core checks only the static representation and schedule consistency. A `selected` outcome names only a manifest-declared-success exit, never acceptance. `reported_outcome` is the adapter's manifest-declared self-report, never result polarity or a verdict. The optional `enforcement` object, when present, must have exactly `environment`, `network`, `filesystem_write`, `filesystem_read`, `process_spawn`, and `memory_bound_mb` keys. It is the agent's self-reported effective dispatch boundary and is checked for shape only; it is not Evidence or a resource-enforcement attestation. Manifest-declared argv, stdin and memory bounds are not attested by this record; embedded evidence_acceptance is carried, not re-judged. No adapter is executed and no grade is promoted. |
| `mumei evidence check-adapter` | 2 | Core checks only the static representation and manifest consistency. Manifest-declared argv and stdin remain inert unless host policy opts in through allow_manifest_attempt_argv and allow_manifest_attempt_stdin; a host argv map takes precedence. Verdict markers describe an adapter self-report vocabulary, never a verdict. max_memory_mb is the adapter's declared ceiling: planning uses the smaller of it and the policy memory bound; a scheduled attempt uses it only when the host declares no memory bound. Core does not enforce it. No adapter is executed and no grade is promoted. |
| `mumei evidence check-attempt-acceptance` | 2 | Core validates the closed representation and producer consistency of a scheduled evidence-check acceptance. `accepted` records the producer's binding of a declared check outcome to its current candidate, never Core Evidence acceptance. `candidate_match` is not rechecked because Core has no attempt-sequence snapshot. No Core check is rerun and no grade is promoted. |
| `mumei evidence accept` | 16 | Normalize one declared requirement against one Evidence record into a bounded verdict; no tool execution or proof acceptance |
| `mumei evidence accept-list` | 16 | Normalize one declared requirement against a bounded Evidence list envelope — per-record verdicts plus an aggregate; no tool execution or proof acceptance |
| `mumei evidence check-list` | 3 | Validate a bounded Evidence list envelope's representation — every record individually, not their truth or consistency |
| `mumei evidence check-consistency` | 3 | Check a bounded Evidence list envelope's cross-record identity-pin agreement, not pin correctness or truth |
| `mumei evidence check-object-acceptance` | 3 | Validate a native object-route acceptance descriptor and optionally project it into Common Evidence v1 |
| `mumei native-bundle` | 0 | Build/check a restricted native identity bundle (not artifact semantic proof) |
| `mumei native-bundle accept-evidence` | 2 | Evaluate a saved native consumer Evidence report against fresh pinned source/LLVM checks into a bounded acceptance descriptor |
| `mumei native-bundle accept-artifact` | 2 | Evaluate pinned artifact reproduction under the recorded toolchain into a bounded acceptance descriptor |
| `mumei native-bundle accept-object` | 6 | Evaluate reproduced object machine code against the verified source within the machine-code TV profile into a bounded acceptance descriptor |
| `mumei native-bundle recheck-evidence` | 1 | Replay a saved native consumer Evidence report against fresh pinned source/LLVM checks, without proof acceptance |
| `mumei native-bundle recheck-object-acceptance` | 14 | Replay a saved accept-object descriptor against a fresh object acceptance, optionally pinning its detached producer signature |
| `mumei native-bundle recheck-llvm` | 2 | Recheck the C03 source and pinned native LLVM body/wrapper snapshot, not object or binary semantics |
| `mumei native-bundle recheck-source` | 1 | Check pinned snapshots and freshly recheck the C03 source postcondition, not LLVM or binary semantics |
| `mumei native-bundle build` | 1 | Freshly verify and build a pure-i64 main on Linux/x86_64 with fixed settings |
| `mumei native-bundle check` | 1 | Check snapshot identities against an externally supplied build ID; does not execute or prove the artifact |
| `mumei native-bundle recheck-artifact` | 1 | Recheck that the toolchain reproduces the pinned object and executable; does not execute or check runtime/ABI semantics |
| `mumei native-bundle recheck-object` | 2 | Recheck object symbols, direct call edges and linked function placement/call targets; no instruction semantics, ABI or runtime claim |
| `mumei native-bundle recheck-machine-tv` | 2 | Compare straight-line and acyclic-branch machine code, including conditional direct calls, with pure-i64 source models under assumed register conventions; no ABI or runtime claim |
| `mumei native-bundle recheck-exit-status` | 1 | Execute the reproduced executable and compare its OS exit status with the record pin; no runtime/ABI semantics |
| `mumei native-bundle accept-exit-status` | 2 | Accept the pinned artifact after the exit-status recheck; emits an anonymous acceptance descriptor, not reusable Evidence |
| `mumei native-bundle recheck-stdout` | 1 | Execute the reproduced executable and compare its captured stdout digest with the record pin; no runtime/ABI semantics |
| `mumei native-bundle accept-stdout` | 2 | Accept the pinned artifact after the stdout recheck; emits an anonymous acceptance descriptor, not reusable Evidence |
| `mumei native-bundle recheck-stderr` | 1 | Execute the reproduced executable and compare its captured stderr digest with the record pin; no runtime/ABI semantics |
| `mumei native-bundle accept-stderr` | 2 | Accept the pinned artifact after the stderr recheck; emits an anonymous acceptance descriptor, not reusable Evidence |
| `mumei native-bundle recheck-observations` | 2 | Execute the reproduced executable once and compare its exit status, stdout and stderr with every record pin; no runtime/ABI semantics |
| `mumei native-bundle accept-observations` | 2 | Accept the artifact chain plus one invocation of the reproduced executable matching every runtime-observation pin; no runtime/ABI semantics |
| `mumei build` | 6 | Verify + compile to LLVM IR (default) |
| `mumei verify` | 38 | Z3 formal verification only (no codegen) |
| `mumei config` | 2 | Show effective settings and where each value comes from. The CLI `--profile` is per-invocation; `mumei config` only reports the manifest source. |
| `mumei proof-store` | 0 | Inspect or prune the local proof store |
| `mumei proof-store stats` | 2 | Show local proof-store entry counts and size |
| `mumei proof-store prune` | 3 | Remove old and/or invalid proof-store entries |
| `mumei check` | 0 | Parse + resolve + monomorphize only (no Z3, fast syntax check) |
| `mumei erosion` | 2 | Compare candidate contracts with a baseline file |
| `mumei init` | 0 | Generate a new Mumei project template |
| `mumei inspect` | 2 | Inspect development environment (Z3, LLVM, std library) |
| `mumei setup` | 1 | Download and configure Z3 + LLVM toolchain into ~/.mumei/ |
| `mumei add` | 4 | Add a dependency to mumei.toml, or install an emitter plugin |
| `mumei publish` | 2 | Publish package to local registry (~/.mumei/packages/) |
| `mumei list` | 0 | List available packages in the local registry |
| `mumei lsp` | 0 | Start Language Server Protocol server (stdio mode) |
| `mumei repl` | 0 | Interactive REPL (Read-Eval-Print Loop) |
| `mumei doc` | 2 | Generate documentation from source comments |

## `mumei`

Formally verified language: parse → resolve → monomorphize → verify (Z3) → codegen (LLVM IR)

Usage:

```text
Usage: mumei [OPTIONS] [INPUT] [COMMAND]
```

### Positional arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `INPUT` | No | Input .mm file (backward compat: `mumei input.mm` = `mumei build input.mm`) |

### Options

| Option | Default | Possible values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-o, --output <OUTPUT>` | katana | — | Output base name (for .ll) |

## `mumei evidence`

Check common Evidence representation or produce fresh scoped source Evidence; no proof acceptance

Usage:

```text
Usage: mumei evidence <COMMAND>
```

## `mumei evidence recheck-source`

Freshly recheck saved source Evidence with linked Z3 and caller-supplied source/budgets; not proof acceptance

Usage:

```text
Usage: mumei evidence recheck-source [OPTIONS] --source <SOURCE> <INPUT>
```

### Positional arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `INPUT` | Yes | One regular common Evidence JSON record (at most 65,536 bytes), not a Native envelope/certificate |

### Options

| Option | Default | Possible values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--source <SOURCE>` | — | — | Separate regular C03 pure-i64 source (at most 65,536 bytes); saved labels/paths are never read |
| `--json` | false | — | Emit a static consistency diagnostic, not Evidence or an acceptance receipt |
| `--solver-timeout <SOLVER_TIMEOUT>` | 10000 | — | Solver timeout in milliseconds (1..=10000); must match the producer's explicit budget |
| `--solver-resource-limit <SOLVER_RESOURCE_LIMIT>` | 1000000 | — | Solver resource units (1..=1000000); no saved/ambient policy is loaded |
| `--produced-at <PRODUCED_AT>` | — | — | Declared RFC 3339 timestamp the producer stamped; must equal the saved record's produced_at |

## `mumei evidence recheck-sidecar`

Freshly recheck a semantic-contract sidecar against caller-supplied source and LLVM IR bytes; hash binding and source-model obligations only, not LLVM correspondence or acceptance

Usage:

```text
Usage: mumei evidence recheck-sidecar [OPTIONS] --source <SOURCE> --artifact <ARTIFACT> <SIDECAR>
```

### Positional arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SIDECAR` | Yes | Regular semantic-contract sidecar JSON (at most 4 MiB) |

### Options

| Option | Default | Possible values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--source <SOURCE>` | — | — | Separate regular source file (at most 65,536 bytes); the saved label is never opened |
| `--artifact <ARTIFACT>` | — | — | Separate regular LLVM IR artifact (at most 16 MiB); hash-bound only |
| `--json` | false | — | Emit a static diagnostic, not evidence or an acceptance receipt |
| `--solver-timeout <SOLVER_TIMEOUT>` | 10000 | — | Solver timeout in milliseconds (1..=10000) |
| `--solver-resource-limit <SOLVER_RESOURCE_LIMIT>` | 1000000 | — | Solver resource units (1..=1000000); zero/unlimited is rejected |

## `mumei evidence accept-sidecar`

Evaluate a semantic-contract sidecar's hash binding and fresh source obligations into a bounded acceptance descriptor

Usage:

```text
Usage: mumei evidence accept-sidecar [OPTIONS] --source <SOURCE> --artifact <ARTIFACT> <SIDECAR>
```

### Positional arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SIDECAR` | Yes | Regular semantic-contract sidecar JSON (at most 4 MiB) |

### Options

| Option | Default | Possible values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--source <SOURCE>` | — | — | Separate regular source file (at most 65,536 bytes); the saved label is never opened |
| `--artifact <ARTIFACT>` | — | — | Separate regular LLVM IR artifact (at most 16 MiB); hash-bound only |
| `--json` | false | — | Emit a static acceptance descriptor, not reusable Evidence or a certificate |
| `--solver-timeout <SOLVER_TIMEOUT>` | 10000 | — | Solver timeout in milliseconds (1..=10000) |
| `--solver-resource-limit <SOLVER_RESOURCE_LIMIT>` | 1000000 | — | Solver resource units (1..=1000000); zero/unlimited is rejected |
| `--signature <SIGNATURE>` | — | — | Regular mumei.producer-signature/v1 envelope file (at most 65,536 bytes) |
| `--producer-key <PRODUCER_KEY>` | — | — | 64-char lowercase-hex ed25519 producer public key |
| `--expected-producer-key <EXPECTED_PRODUCER_KEY>` | — | — | Pin the unsigned producer key id to the supplied key; required for registry/revocation checks |
| `--reference-time <REFERENCE_TIME>` | — | — | Declared RFC 3339 reference time for freshness and registry checks |
| `--max-age-seconds <MAX_AGE_SECONDS>` | — | — | Maximum envelope age in seconds |
| `--key-registry <KEY_REGISTRY>` | — | — | Regular mumei.producer-key-registry/v1 file (at most 65,536 bytes); requires a pinned producer key id |
| `--registry-signature <REGISTRY_SIGNATURE>` | — | — | Regular mumei.producer-signature/v1 registry signature file |
| `--registry-key <REGISTRY_KEY>` | — | — | 64-char lowercase-hex ed25519 registry root public key |
| `--revocation-list <REVOCATION_LIST>` | — | — | Regular mumei.key-revocation-list/v1 or /v2 file (at most 65,536 bytes); requires a pinned producer key id |
| `--revocation-signature <REVOCATION_SIGNATURE>` | — | — | Regular mumei.producer-signature/v1 revocation-list signature file |
| `--revocation-key <REVOCATION_KEY>` | — | — | 64-char lowercase-hex ed25519 revocation root public key |
| `--min-revocation-version <MIN_REVOCATION_VERSION>` | — | — | Minimum acceptable v2 version; checks not_after and requires a root-signed list and reference time |

## `mumei evidence verify-source`

Freshly verify one C03 pure-i64 source postcondition, not LLVM/artifacts or proof acceptance

Usage:

```text
Usage: mumei evidence verify-source [OPTIONS] <INPUT>
```

### Positional arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `INPUT` | Yes | Regular source at most 65,536 bytes; one pure-i64 comparison/conditional atom, explicit clauses, at most 16 parameters and literal true precondition |

### Options

| Option | Default | Possible values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | false | — | Emit one common Evidence v1 record on fresh unsat only (not an acceptance receipt) |
| `--solver-timeout <SOLVER_TIMEOUT>` | 10000 | — | Solver timeout in milliseconds (1..=10000); no project/ambient policy loaded |
| `--solver-resource-limit <SOLVER_RESOURCE_LIMIT>` | 1000000 | — | Solver resource units (1..=1000000); zero/unlimited is rejected |
| `--produced-at <PRODUCED_AT>` | — | — | Declared RFC 3339 timestamp stamped on the emitted record; never read from the system clock |

|---|---|---|

## `mumei evidence sign`

Detachably sign a bounded record's raw bytes with a declared ed25519 key into a producer-signature envelope; binds the declared key id only

Usage:

```text
Usage: mumei evidence sign [OPTIONS] --key-file <KEY_FILE> --producer-key-id <PRODUCER_KEY_ID> [INPUT]
```

### Positional arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `INPUT` | No | Regular file (at most 4 MiB (4,194,304 bytes)) whose raw bytes become the signed subject; never parsed or canonicalized |

### Options

| Option | Default | Possible values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--stdin` | false | — | Read the record bytes from standard input (at most 4 MiB (4,194,304 bytes)); never infer stdin from a missing file |
| `--json` | false | — | Emit the detached mumei.producer-signature/v1 envelope, not a verification or acceptance result |
| `--key-file <KEY_FILE>` | — | — | Regular file holding exactly the 64-char lowercase-hex ed25519 secret key; the value is never printed |
| `--producer-key-id <PRODUCER_KEY_ID>` | — | — | Caller-declared producer key label the consumer pins separately; never derived from the key bytes |
| `--produced-at <PRODUCED_AT>` | — | — | Optional declared production timestamp stamped into the envelope (RFC 3339, excluding leap seconds); unsigned like the key id — freshness is a consumer-side check |

## `mumei evidence keygen`

Generate a fresh ed25519 producer keypair; writes the 64-char hex secret to a new file and prints only the public key

Usage:

```text
Usage: mumei evidence keygen --secret-file <SECRET_FILE>
```
### Options

| Option | Default | Possible values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--secret-file <SECRET_FILE>` | — | — | New regular file receiving the 64-char lowercase-hex ed25519 secret key; must not already exist |

## `mumei verify`

Z3 formal verification only (no codegen)

Usage:

```text
Usage: mumei verify [OPTIONS] <INPUT>
```

### Positional arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `INPUT` | Yes | Input .mm file or directory |

### Options

#### Profile and strictness

| Option | Default | Possible values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile <PROFILE>` | — | strict, audit | Opt-in preset that turns on a group of verify checks (strict, audit); explicit flags still apply and a profile never turns a flag off |
| `--strict-imports` | false | — | P5-C: Strict import mode — missing/invalid certificates cause hard errors |
| `--strict-array-types` | false | — | Opt-in strict mode: treat unannotated array accesses (which default to the `i64` element sort) as errors instead of warnings. Off by default, preserving the backward-compatible `i64` fallback |
| `--warn-fragment` | false | — | Emit outside_decidable_fragment warnings for atoms outside the Z3-stable fragment |
| `--warn-untyped-arrays` | false | — | Emit `untyped_array_access` warnings when an array is accessed as `arr[i]` without an explicit `[i64]`/`[f64]`/`[bool]` element-type annotation (which silently falls back to `i64`). Warning-only; does not change the verification encoding |

#### Solver and proof

| Option | Default | Possible values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--solver-timeout <SOLVER_TIMEOUT>` | — | — | Override Z3 solver timeout in milliseconds |
| `--cache-scope <CACHE_SCOPE>` | module | module, global | Verification cache scope: module (input directory) or global (current workspace) |
| `--proof-store` | false | — | Reuse Z3-verified proofs from the opt-in local proof store |
| `--escalate-lean` | false | — | Escalate Z3 unknown obligations to Lean 4 via mumei-lean bridge |
| `--allow-lean-verified` | false | — | PR 2: Accept mumei-lean-emitted certificates (`z3_check_result == "lean_verified"`) as proven during import resolution. Off by default for backwards compatibility |
| `--proof-cert` | false | — | Generate Z3 proof certificate (.proof.json) |
| `--ieee754-f64` | false | — | Opt-in IEEE 754 (binary64) verification for `f64`: encode `f64` as Z3 `Float(11,53)` with round-nearest-even FP arithmetic instead of the default exact-rational `Real` encoding. Models rounding so e.g. `0.1 + 0.2 != 0.3` holds. Default off (keeps `Real` semantics) |
| `--bitvec-i64` | false | — | Opt-in bit-vector verification for `i64`: encode `i64` as Z3 `BV(64)` so `&`, `\|`, `^`, `<<`, `>>` have real bit semantics and `+`, `-`, `*` wrap in two's complement like machine arithmetic, instead of the default unbounded `Int` encoding. Default off (keeps `Int` semantics and existing proof certificates) |
| `--check-i64-overflow` | false | — | Opt-in fixed-width check under the default `Int` encoding: reject a body `+`, `-` or `*` whose `i64` operands give a result outside the `i64` range, where compiled code would wrap or panic. Contracts keep unbounded arithmetic. Default off |

#### Diagnostics

| Option | Default | Possible values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--enable-spurious-detection` | false | — | Enable P8-A spurious counterexample detection |
| `--disable-spurious-detection` | false | — | Disable P8-A spurious counterexample detection |
| `--enable-vacuity-check` | false | — | Enable spec vacuity checking via mutation testing |
| `--detect-loops` | false | — | Detect loops that may need stronger invariants |
| `--suggest-cegis` | false | — | Include CEGIS loop-invariant suggestions in JSON/report output |
| `--detect-spec-drift <DETECT_SPEC_DRIFT>` | — | — | Path to an old proof certificate for spec drift detection |
| `--cross-spec-verify` | false | — | Enable cross-specification consistency verification across atoms and emit cross_spec.json with agent_artifact_mapping |
| `--cross-spec-files <CROSS_SPEC_FILES>` | — | — | Additional .mm files to include in cross-specification verification; contract_consistency/global_invariant_conflicts/circular_dependencies map to mumei-agent missing_constraints/divergences/drift_issues |

#### Property-based testing

| Option | Default | Possible values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--property-based-test` | false | — | Run property-based validation synthesized from refinement types |
| `--property-based-test-count <PROPERTY_BASED_TEST_COUNT>` | 100 | — | Number of generated property-based inputs per atom |
| `--property-based-test-seed <PROPERTY_BASED_TEST_SEED>` | — | — | Seed for deterministic property-based input generation |
| `--property-based-test-max-shrink-steps <PROPERTY_BASED_TEST_MAX_SHRINK_STEPS>` | 64 | — | Maximum property-based shrinking steps per counterexample |

#### Output and artifacts

| Option | Default | Possible values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | false | — | Output verification report as JSON to stdout |
| `--emit <FORMAT>` | — | — | Emit format: "sarif" writes report.sarif; "loss-vector" prints P9-E Loss Vector JSON; "escalation-bundle" writes .escalation-bundle.json; "proof-graph" writes proof_graph.json for the interactive visualizer |
| `--no-emit <NO_EMIT>` | — | — | Disable verify-only output targets: escalation-metrics |
| `--output <OUTPUT>` | — | — | Output path for proof certificate or escalation bundle |
| `--report-dir <REPORT_DIR>` | — | — | Directory to write report.json into (default: current directory) |
| `--keep-phase-artifacts <DIR>` | — | — | Preserve per-atom SMT queries and verification phase outcomes |
| `--emit-contract-manifest` | false | — | Emit a contract manifest containing per-atom specification hashes |
| `--task-id <TASK_ID>` | — | — | Verification task ID for MCP/CI provenance |

#### Harness metadata

| Option | Default | Possible values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--harness-contract <HARNESS_CONTRACT>` | — | — | Harness contract path or identifier to embed in generated proof certificates |
| `--intent-fidelity <INTENT_FIDELITY>` | — | — | Intent fidelity metadata JSON to embed in generated proof certificates |
| `--artifact-paths <ARTIFACT_PATHS>` | — | — | Comma-separated artifact paths to embed in generated proof certificates |
| `--budget-policy-fingerprint <BUDGET_POLICY_FINGERPRINT>` | — | — | Budget policy fingerprint to embed in generated proof certificates |

## `mumei verify-cert`

Verify a proof certificate against current source

Usage:

```text
Usage: mumei verify-cert [OPTIONS] <CERT> <INPUT>
```

### Positional arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `CERT` | Yes | Proof certificate file (.proof.json) |
| `INPUT` | Yes | Source .mm file to verify against |

### Options

| Option | Default | Possible values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--allow-lean-verified` | false | — | PR 2: Accept mumei-lean-emitted certificates (`z3_check_result == "lean_verified"`) as proven. Off by default — only Z3-discharged (`unsat`) atoms are accepted |
| `--strict` | false | — | Treat drifted certificates as failures: exit non-zero when an atom is reported `changed` or when the certificate carries no `certificate_hash` to re-derive. Intended for CI gates that distribute certificates alongside sources |

## `mumei claims`

Summarize atom evidence and its freshness in a Claim Book

Usage:

```text
Usage: mumei claims [OPTIONS] <INPUT>
```

### Positional arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `INPUT` | Yes | Input .mm file |

### Options

| Option | Default | Possible values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--cert <CERT>` | — | — | Proof certificate path (defaults to the path written by `mumei verify --proof-cert`) |
| `--allow-lean-verified` | false | — | Accept current Lean-verified certificate evidence |
| `--format <FORMAT>` | both | json, md, both | Output format: json, md, or both |
| `--out-dir <OUT_DIR>` | . | — | Directory for claimbook.json and CLAIMBOOK.md (default: current directory) |
| `--observations <OBSERVATIONS>` | — | — | Attach observations from a mumei.test-harvest/v1 file |
| `--controls` | false | — | Attach negative-control results to claims |
| `--max-mutants <MAX_MUTANTS>` | 32 | — | Maximum mutants to test per atom (requires --controls) |
| `--require-discriminating` | false | — | Fail if any checked claim has weak or inconclusive controls |
| `--require-complete` | false | — | Require non-empty claims with complete dependency coverage |
| `--require-grade <REQUIRE_GRADE>` | — | G0, G1, G2, G3, G4, G5 | Require every claim to meet this Seal Grade |
| `--require-evidence-acceptance <REQUIREMENT_LIST>` | — | — | Require a promotable acceptance triple: <requirement-list> <evidence> <acceptance> — the gate fails closed unless the mumei.evidence-requirement-list-acceptance/v1 descriptor pins these declared inputs with verdict accepted |
